24b93a16-7495-44c7-8800-ceeefbaee9c6.line: 新笔配旧图纸，下午画的线条都听话了不少。

items.imgPrompt: small purple-brown Yixing clay teapot with bamboo relief carving, on a dark wooden tea tray with matching cup, soft window light, faint tea stain inside rim

desc.zh: 家中原有兩把同款。一隻是李先生所贈，老朽捨不得用；這隻是老朽自購的，養了幾年，還算溫潤。好物不該蒙塵，轉予有緣人。
desc.zh_cn: 家中原有两把同款。一只是李先生所赠，老朽舍不得用；这只是老朽自购的，养了几年，还算温润。好物不该蒙尘，转予有缘人。
desc.en: I had two identical pots. The one Mr. Li gave me, I could never bring myself to use. This one I bought myself and seasoned with care. A good pot shouldn't sit in dust — it goes to whoever fate chooses.

items.imgPrompt: slim tai chi sword, polished steel blade, red silk tassel, black wooden scabbard, laid across worn parquet floor by a balcony door, light scratches on grip

desc.zh: 練了三十年太極，去年膝蓋先老朽一步認了輸。劍是好劍，只劈過晨霧，未沾過別的。望它隨新主人繼續迎朝陽。
desc.zh_cn: 练了三十年太极，去年膝盖先老朽一步认了输。剑是好剑，只劈过晨雾，未沾过别的。望它随新主人继续迎朝阳。
desc.en: Thirty years of tai chi, until last year my knees surrendered before I did. A fine sword — it has only ever cut morning mist. May it greet the sunrise under a new master.

items.imgPrompt: rosewood erhu with pale snakeskin resonator, leaning against a floral fabric armchair in a lived-in living room, thin dust on strings, bow draped over body

desc.zh: 退休後一時興起學的，無奈手指比老朽的脾氣還硬，拉出的調子連樓下的貓都要抗議。琴是無辜的，錯在老朽。附琴盒與備用弦。
desc.zh_cn: 退休后一时兴起学的，无奈手指比老朽的脾气还硬，拉出的调子连楼下的猫都要抗议。琴是无辜的，错在老朽。附琴盒与备用弦。
desc.en: Took it up on a whim after retiring. Alas, my fingers turned out stiffer than my temper — even the cat downstairs filed complaints. The instrument is innocent; the fault is entirely mine. Case and spare strings included.

items.imgPrompt: matte black cylindrical smart speaker with grey fabric mesh, on a lace doily atop a dark rosewood side table, pristine, original cardboard box standing behind

desc.zh: 李先生所贈，說是時下最時興、還會自己開口的物件。老朽擺弄半日，它講它的，老朽一句沒聽懂，索性原樣收起。近乎全新，原盒俱在。此事……懇請莫在李先生面前提起。
desc.zh_cn: 李先生所赠，说是时下最时兴、还会自己开口的物件。老朽摆弄半日，它讲它的，老朽一句没听懂，索性原样收起。近乎全新，原盒俱在。此事……恳请莫在李先生面前提起。
desc.en: A gift from Mr. Li — 'all the rage,' he insisted, one that even talks back. I fiddled for half a day; it spoke its mind, I understood not a word. Nearly new, box intact. And this matter… I'd be much obliged if it never reached Mr. Li's ears.

items.imgPrompt: tall green glass wine bottle with dark red wax capsule, label turned away, standing on a carved wooden cabinet beside tea canisters, faint dust on shoulder

desc.zh: 供貨商硬塞的謝禮，老朽從不收重禮，退又退不掉，偏巧醫生又禁了老朽的酒。原封未動，塵都替諸位積了一層。錢是小事，莫辜負好酒。
desc.zh_cn: 供货商硬塞的谢礼，老朽从不收重礼，退又退不掉，偏巧医生又禁了老朽的酒。原封未动，尘都替诸位积了一层。钱是小事，莫辜负好酒。
desc.en: A supplier's stubborn token of thanks. I never accept lavish gifts, yet this refused to be returned — and my doctor has since banned my evening sip. Sealed, untouched, gathering a polite layer of dust on your behalf. The price is a trifle; don't waste good wine.

items.imgPrompt: charcoal grey pinstriped wool waistcoat with satin back, draped over a wooden chair in a dim hallway, brass coat stand behind, no visible wear

desc.zh: 在Souvenir站了幾十年，衣裳攢得比老朽的精神頭還多。這件只上過兩回身，如今腰身卻瞞不住人了。好料子，壓箱底可惜，熨燙平整後寄出。
desc.zh_cn: 在Souvenir站了几十年，衣裳攒得比老朽的精神头还多。这件只上过两回身，如今腰身却瞒不住人了。好料子，压箱底可惜，熨烫平整后寄出。
desc.en: Decades at Souvenir's front room — I've collected more waistcoats than stamina. This one served only two evenings before my waistline gave me away. Fine wool; a shame to leave it boxed. I'll press it crisp before posting.
